prompt: Explain this repository: what applications or packages it contains, how its architecture is organized, which technology stack it uses, and which important invariants developers must follow. Inspect the repository read-only. Do not use the eval itself or previous artifacts in .agents/evals/repository-overview as sources of information about the repository. Support substantive claims with relative file paths. Structure the answer using the sections "Applications and packages", "Architecture", "Technology stack", and "Invariants".

assertions.description: The answer describes applications or packages
The answer has an architecture section
The answer has a technology stack section
The answer cites at least two real repository files
The agent consults a repository README when one exists
The agent consults a package or workspace manifest when one exists
The agent does not use the eval or previous eval artifacts as repository sources
